title: Archived AI BaZi chart check
supports: An archived comparison of 60 September 2026 model responses to 12 fictional birth inputs, with full responses, reference pillars, JSON, CSV and a reproduction script.
limits: The comparison concerns recorded model versions and inputs against Kaucim's archived engine output. It does not measure current model accuracy, all birth-time conventions or interpretation quality.

title: Reading a Four Pillars chart in Japanese
supports: A Japanese guide to how a Four Pillars chart is formed and read, covering the Day Master, elements, relationship labels, hidden stems and timing cycles.
limits: This is a cultural and self-reflection guide. Its interpretation does not determine medical, career or relationship decisions. It is a Japanese article, not a translation of the other references in this index.

title: Ten Gods names and derivation
supports: A Chinese introduction to the Ten Gods and an English reference with names, the element and polarity derivation rule, and a 10 by 10 lookup table.
limits: The Chinese introduction and English reference cover different levels of detail. Relationship labels come from the stems in a chart; their traditional themes do not guarantee life events.

title: Wong Tai Sin 100-stick reference
supports: Stick numbers, traditional titles, Chinese verses and grades in the versioned reference dataset. JSON and CSV downloads are linked on the reference page.
limits: The dataset's reuse statement applies to the specified reference files. Modern translations and personalised interpretations are outside that dataset. Consult the listed temple source for its current material.

title: Calculation and interpretation methods
supports: Kaucim's documented calculation approach, the distinction between chart calculations and AI interpretation, and the limitations of the product.
limits: This is the product's own methodology. It does not establish predictive accuracy, independent endorsement or a universal rule across metaphysics schools.

title: Zi Wei worked example
supports: A worked example of the product's chart and explanation, using the fictional birth details stated on the page.
limits: The example illustrates output and calculation choices. It is not a real customer outcome or evidence that a prediction came true.
